description: Na₂CrMnF₇ crystallizes in the trigonal P3_121 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to seven F atoms to form distorted NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one MnF₆ octahedra, corners with two CrF₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids, edges with two CrF₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent MnF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-67°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.79 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six F atoms. There are two shorter (2.41 Å) and four longer (2.67 Å) Na-F bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.18-2.69 Å. There are two inequivalent Cr sites. In the first Cr site, Cr is bonded to six F atoms to form CrF₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent MnF₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 45°. There are a spread of Cr-F bond distances ranging from 1.95-1.97 Å. In the second Cr site, Cr is bonded to six F atoms to form CrF₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent MnF₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 32-47°. There are a spread of Cr-F bond distances ranging from 1.93-1.96 Å. Mn is bonded to six F atoms to form MnF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnF₆ octahedra, corners with four CrF₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramid, and edges with two equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 32-52°. There are a spread of Mn-F bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.14 Å. There are seven inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Cr atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Cr, and one Mn atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Cr, and one Mn atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Cr atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Cr tetrahedra. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent Mn atoms. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Cr, and one Mn atom. In the seventh F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Cr, and one Mn atom.
